name: book-writer
description: Codex skills for generating children's books from story ideas to EPUB export

interface.shortDescription: Generate children's books, illustrations, and EPUB exports.
interface.longDescription: Book Writer helps generate children's books from source material: story ideas, character profiles, full chapters, cover images, chapter illustrations, and final EPUB files.
defaultPrompt: Generate a children's story idea from my notes.
Prepare character profiles for this story.
Convert my chapter markdown files to EPUB.
